name: Pennsylvania (PGCB) Market Profile

bindingStandards.name: 58 Pa. Code Ch. 461a (slot machine, table game device, interactive game, sports wagering device, VGT and associated equipment testing and controls)

minimum.value: 85% minimum, and must not equal or exceed 100%
minimum.source: 58 Pa. Code section 461a.7(a) (MEDIUM); PGCB Technical Standard section 461b.6 (HIGH)
minimum.notes: Computed at the LOWEST possible single-play wager for the 85% floor, and at the HIGHEST eligible wager for the sub-100% ceiling. PGCB Technical Standard section 461b.6 (Software Submissions) states that a theoretical payout percentage below 85% or at/above 100% WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED OR APPROVED. Identical rule for VGTs at section 1112a.7(a). Whether a distinct interactive-game figure exists is UNVERIFIED.
minimum.engineeringImplication: Because the floor is measured at the LOWEST single-play wager, any design where RTP rises with stake (ante bet, extra paylines unlocked by higher stakes) risks failing at the minimum bet. See steering/math-verification.md section 3.2.

selfExclusion.nationalScheme: PGCB Self-Exclusion Programs - SEPARATE Casino, iGaming, VGT and Fantasy lists
selfExclusion.notes: FOUR separate lists. This is the strongest example of why a self-exclusion integration must not assume one list per jurisdiction. Also https://responsibleplay.pa.gov/self-exclusion/

recentChanges.change: PGCB gaming revenue exceeded USD 7B for the first time (context only)

verificationRequired: Whether a distinct interactive-game minimum RTP exists (e.g. 58 Pa. Code Ch. 809a/810a) or whether 461a.7's 85% governs interactive games
Minimum game cycle duration, stake and win caps, autoplay treatment
consultantNotes: Pennsylvania has the highest confirmed RTP floor among the US states researched (85%), and unusually the technical standard states outright that non-conforming submissions will not be considered. This makes PA a good anchor market for setting a catalogue-wide minimum RTP.
The lowest-wager measurement basis is the practical trap. Verify the RTP at the minimum bet, not the headline configuration.
